name: Nychthemeron
tagline: A ephemeral social network that resets itself every 24 hours.
story: Nychthemeron creates a unique social network experience where everything vanishes after 24 hours. The entire platform completely resets, leaving no trace—except for your account. It's a thought-provoking exploration of temporary digital connections and what it means when nothing is meant to last.

name: Low-tech Magazine
tagline: A solar-powered magazine about sustainable technology.
story: Low-tech Magazine is a great example of a website whose design follows its subject. Its solar-powered server can go offline when the battery is low, turning energy use into part of the reading experience.
